data.narrative:
Orqa is a Series A drone and autonomous systems company that has raised approximately $22M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises eight private companies in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air; no direct public comparables exist in this category.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using total capital raised ($22M) as a proxy for enterprise value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage step-ups yields an implied valuation of $44M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—only one adjacent-stage datapoint was identified among the five same-sector peers, falling below the three-company minimum threshold for statistical validity.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $37M to $51M, with a median point of $44M. This estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single methodology and the thin comparable dataset within the Drones & Autonomous space. Key sensitivities include capital efficiency relative to peer fundraising patterns, revenue traction not disclosed in available data, and the nascent nature of the autonomous systems market, which limits historical precedent for stage-specific valuation multiples.
